_about: Typical compression ratios (compressed / packed bytes), used to predict the installer size before the first build on this PC. Measured on the MoonGamers build of this installer with Inno Setup 7.1, not on a build of this template, so they are an estimate - a real full build of the template should replace them. Once this PC has built, build\size-history.json is used instead.

full|lzma2/ultra64.note: Retail game + expansions with every extra: about 2,367 MB packed into 1,974 MB (MoonGamers build)

full|lzma2/ultra64|smallest.note: Same files with -Smallest (one stream, 1 GB dictionary): packed into 1,871 MB (MoonGamers build)

quick|lzma2/ultra64.note: -Quick build (components only): about 342 MB packed into 268 MB (MoonGamers build)
